You are verifying a batch of code-review findings for PR #81 (ZimmermannAU/zimmermann-pwa, "feat(pdp): SFCC-731 product gallery + full-bleed hero layout") — briefed in FINDINGS MODE, not scoring-the-PR mode. You are NOT scoring overall PR quality on six axes. For each finding below: reproduce it or say you could not, then return exactly one of CONFIRMED (reproduced from source), PLAUSIBLE (consistent with what you read, decisive evidence missing — say exactly what would settle it), or UNSUPPORTED (the citation does not support the claim — say what is actually true). Where a finding's conclusion is broader than its search supports, downgrade it and say so. Do not fix anything — verification only.

WORKTREE (already checked out, dependencies installed): /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-marcel-a-n-navarro-Dev-zimmermann-pwa/37973080-8be5-46e1-9aab-e2abcb81ea17/scratchpad/pr81-head (commit 6284ea3511305524156489a6c0e811a85bb2a17a). Base for comparison: .../pr81-base (commit 4cdfb47f324ce533079345ab7aa1203e4a5af734 = current origin/develop tip).

These findings were produced by five independent review sub-agents plus my own direct investigation (which included live browser testing against the PR's deployed MRT preview and direct git/source inspection) — treat all of them as unverified claims to test, not settled fact.

## Finding 1 — AC 16 not implemented, mislabeled as done
Jira SFCC-731 AC 16: "Given a shopper clicks a model avatar thumbnail, then the gallery scrolls to the corresponding image set for that model." Claim: `zimmGalleryOverlay/index.tsx:229-256`'s `thumbnailStrip` is a plain per-IMAGE jump strip (one thumbnail per media array item, no model-grouping concept anywhere in `ZimmGalleryMediaItem`'s type or `mapImageGroupsToGalleryMedia.ts`), yet `index.test.tsx:100`'s describe block is titled `'ZimmGalleryOverlay — thumbnail strip (AC 14/16)'` and `index.stories.tsx:95` has a comment `/** AC 16 — clicking a thumbnail scrolls the stack to that image. */`, both claiming this satisfies AC16. Verify: does any model/avatar-grouping concept exist anywhere in the codebase this PR touches, and do the test/story really claim AC16 compliance for a feature that's actually per-image not per-model?

## Finding 2 — bundle.jsx contract violation: new full-screen overlay lands inside an already-open modal
Claim: `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/product-view-modal/bundle.jsx` is one of the base modules redirected to the Zimmermann `ProductView` override, and unlike its sibling `product-view-modal/index.jsx:44` and `bonus-product-view-modal/index.jsx:466` (which both pass `imageSize="sm"`), `bundle.jsx` never passes `imageSize` on either of its two `<ProductView>` calls — meaning it silently gets `imageSize='md'` (the new gallery + full-screen `ZimmGalleryOverlay`) instead of the base `ImageGallery`. This directly contradicts `product-view/index.tsx:285-291`'s own comment, which claims "bundle paths" are protected `imageSize="sm"` callers. Verify by reading `bundle.jsx` directly and confirming what `imageSize` (if any) it passes, and independently confirm the `product-view/index.tsx` comment's claim about bundle paths.

## Finding 3 — Real unresolved merge conflict: ZimmButton `ariaDisabled`/`ariaDescribedBy` (already on develop, from merged PR for SFCC-92) vs this PR's new `sx` prop
Claim: run `git merge-tree $(git merge-base origin/develop origin/feature/sfcc-731-pdp-gallery) origin/develop origin/feature/sfcc-731-pdp-gallery -- overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmButton/index.tsx` (or equivalent) and confirm there's a real, unresolved textual conflict in that file between develop's current state (which has `ariaDisabled`/`ariaDescribedBy` props, added by an already-merged PR for SFCC-92) and this PR branch's own version (which lacks those but adds `sx`). Confirm both features are real and mutually non-conflicting in intent, but git cannot auto-merge because both touch the same destructured-props line and same JSX spread locations.

## Finding 4 — Zero translation-file coverage for 14 new i18n message keys
Claim: `zimmMediaTile/index.tsx`, `zimmGalleryOverlay/index.tsx`, `zimmProductGallery/index.tsx` together define 14 new `defineMessages` keys (e.g. `product_gallery.video.play`, `gallery_overlay.trigger.close`, `product_gallery.dot.label`, etc.) via `id: '...'` fields — grep for `id: '` in those three files to get the exact list. None of these key prefixes (`gallery_overlay.` / `product_gallery.`) appear anywhere in ANY of the 25 locale JSON files under `translations/` or `overrides/app/static/translations/compiled/` — verify via `grep -rc "gallery_overlay\.\|product_gallery\." translations/*.json overrides/app/static/translations/compiled/*.json` and confirm every file reports 0. Also confirm via `git diff <base>..<head> -- translations/ overrides/app/static/translations/` that this PR makes zero changes to either directory.

## Finding 5 — globalStyles.ts Tier 2 governance gap (not this PR's fault, but confirm the mechanism)
Claim: `overrides/app/theme/globalStyles.ts` is documented as Tier 2 (UI-designer-owned) in both `.claude/rules/frozenFiles.md` and `.claude/rules/protectedFiles.md`, but (a) CODEOWNERS has no line matching this exact path (only `overrides/app/theme/components/` is covered), (b) `.github/workflows/protected-file-guard.yml`'s Tier 2 glob is `overrides/app/theme/components/**` which cannot match the sibling file, and (c) the bot's actual "Tier 2 Protected Files Detected" comment already posted on this live PR (`gh pr view 81` / `gh api repos/ZimmermannAU/zimmermann-pwa/issues/81/comments`) lists only `overrides/app/theme/components/index.ts` under files affected, omitting `globalStyles.ts` even though this PR modifies both. Verify (a) and (b) by reading CODEOWNERS and the workflow file directly; verify (c) by checking the actual bot comment on PR 81.

## Finding 6 — Mobile LCP: compact carousel's first tile is unconditionally `eager={false}`
Claim: `zimmProductGallery/index.tsx` (check around the compact/mobile carousel render, search for `eager={false}` near a comment about "Never eager here, even for i === 0") hardcodes the compact carousel's first tile as non-eager regardless of viewport, while `desktopColumn`'s first stacked tile keeps `eager={i === 0 && !lazy}`. Since `desktopColumn`/`compactColumn` are both always mounted (CSS-only visibility toggle per breakpoint, confirmed by reading the component), a mobile shopper's actually-visible, above-the-fold hero image now loads with `loading="lazy"` instead of eager/priority — the opposite of what AGENTS.md's stated top priority ("Mobile page speed is a top priority... LCP budget is tight ≤2s at p75 MOBILE") would want, and a reversal of which viewport CodeRabbit's own fix comment prioritized ("Desktop now keeps eager/LCP priority"). Verify the code confirms this exactly, and sanity-check whether base SFCC's own `ImageGallery` (still used for imageSize="sm") has an equivalent eager-hero mechanism for comparison context (not to excuse it, just for scale of the gap).

## Finding 7 — AC 9 dot-bar suppressed at media.length===1, undocumented deviation
Claim: `zimmProductGallery/index.tsx` gates the dot indicator bar behind `media.length > 1 &&`, so a single-image product on mobile shows no dot bar at all, contradicting AC9's literal text ("...a dot indicator bar regardless of media count"). Verify the exact line and confirm there's no design/product sign-off citation for this specific deviation anywhere in the diff or commit messages (contrast with AC11's button-visibility decision, which the code comments explicitly attribute to "design team correction, 2026-09-05").

## Finding 8 — ZimmButton `sx`-based `galleryButton` bypasses its own size="lg" recipe and uses a mismatched height token
Claim: `zimmProductGallery.css.ts`'s `galleryButton` (consumed via `sx`) fully substitutes ZimmButton's `size="lg"` styling rather than using/fixing it, and uses `height: 'var(--zimm-size-action-height-lg)'` (resolves to `actionSizes.height.lg` = 52px in `foundation/sizes.ts`) — 2px different from `zimmButton.css.ts`'s own `BTN_HEIGHT_LG` constant (50px) used by the in-recipe `sizes.lg`. Also claim: two of the object's typography properties (`lineHeight`, `letterSpacing`) use raw JS-imported values instead of the `var(--zimm-font-lineheight-3xs)`/`var(--zimm-font-letterspacing-sm)` equivalents that already exist in `zimmTokens.ts`, inconsistent with the object's other typography properties which do use the var() form. Verify both the 50px-vs-52px mismatch and the inconsistent var()-usage claim by reading all three files directly.

## Finding 9 — mapImageGroupsToGalleryMedia recomputed twice per render with fresh array identity, defeating useMemo
Claim: `product-view/index.tsx` calls `mapImageGroupsToGalleryMedia(product.imageGroups, variationParams)` independently at two separate JSX call sites (once for `ZimmProductGallery`, once for `ZimmGalleryOverlay`), each producing a new array reference every render, while `ZimmProductGallery`'s internal `useMemo`s (`stackedItems`/`gridItems`/`gridRows`) depend on that `media` prop by identity — so those memos recompute on every parent re-render (e.g. a quantity change), not just on an actual image/variation change. Verify both call sites exist as described and that the consuming useMemo dependency arrays are indeed keyed on the `media` reference.

## Finding 10 — `thumbnail` recipe part in zimmGalleryOverlay has no `_hover` state, unlike every other clickable control in the same file
Claim: `zimmGalleryOverlay.css.ts`'s `thumbnail` part (backing a raw `<chakra.button>`, not a ZimmButton) defines `_focusVisible` but no `_hover`/`_active`/`_disabled`, while `closeButton` and `galleryDot` (both ZimmButton-wrapped, in the same file/sibling file) fully delegate hover/active/disabled states via `zimmButton.css.ts`'s `icon` variant. Verify by reading the full `thumbnail` style object and confirming no hover state exists anywhere for it (including checking it isn't handled via a different mechanism you might find, like a `:hover &` selector elsewhere).

## Finding 11 — 102px and 720px each typed twice (once as a CSS rem string, once as a bare JS number) with no shared constant, despite an unused same-PR precedent
Claim: `zimmGalleryOverlay.css.ts:104`'s `width: '6.375rem', // 102px` and `zimmGalleryOverlay/index.tsx`'s `THUMBNAIL_DISPLAY_WIDTH = 102` are tied only by a prose comment, not a shared source; same pattern for `zimmGalleryOverlay.css.ts:15`'s `BODY_MAX_WIDTH = '45rem' // 720px` vs `index.tsx`'s `IMAGE_WIDTHS = {..., lg: 720}`. Claim: this same PR already has the correct pattern to follow elsewhere (`zimmColourSwatchGroupShared.ts`, a cross-file shared-constant module explicitly modeled on `theme/components/footerShared.ts`'s precedent) but the gallery/overlay/mediaTile trio has no equivalent `*Shared.ts` file. Verify both duplicated-value pairs and confirm (via `find`) that no such shared file exists for the gallery components.

## Finding 12 — offeredColourCount re-implements ZimmColourSwatchGroup's own internal gating filter (CodeRabbit nitpick, still open)
Claim: `zimmGalleryOverlay/index.tsx` has a line computing `offeredColourCount` via `(colourValues ?? []).filter((v) => Boolean(v.imageUrl) && v.orderable !== false).length` — and `zimmColourSwatchGroup/index.tsx` applies the exact same predicate (`Boolean(v.imageUrl) && v.orderable !== false`) internally to decide which colours it actually renders/offers. Verify both lines exist with matching predicates, confirm this is a real, currently-harmless (values match today) but driftable duplication, not a live bug.

For each of the 12 findings, respond with: finding number, verdict (CONFIRMED/PLAUSIBLE/UNSUPPORTED), one or two sentences of reasoning citing the exact file:line you checked, and if PLAUSIBLE, exactly what additional evidence would settle it. Keep the whole response focused — this is a verification pass, not a rewrite of the findings.

A diff-wide grep for "avatar" returns nothing.

**Finding 2 — CONFIRMED.** `node_modules/.../product-view-modal/bundle.jsx` has two `<ProductView>` calls (parent, child) and neither passes `imageSize` (confirmed by reading the full file — zero matches for `imageSize`), vs. `product-view-modal/index.jsx:44` and `bonus-product-view-modal/index.jsx:466`, which both literally pass `imageSize="sm"`. `product-view/index.tsx:292` defaults the omitted prop to `imageSize = 'md'`, which routes into the `ZimmProductGallery`+`ZimmGalleryOverlay` branch at `index.tsx:817-833` whenever `showImageGallery` is true — true for bundle.jsx's parent product on mobile (`showImageGallery={trueIfMobile}`, `bundle.jsx`'s own `useBreakpointValue({base:true, lg:false})`). The comment at `product-view/index.tsx:285-291` explicitly (and here, wrongly) lists "bundle paths" among the protected `imageSize="sm"` callers.

**Finding 3 — CONFIRMED.** `git merge-tree $(git merge-base origin/develop origin/feature/sfcc-731-pdp-gallery) origin/develop origin/feature/sfcc-731-pdp-gallery` produces a real `<<<<<<< .our / ======= / >>>>>>> .their` conflict on `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmButton/index.tsx`'s destructuring line — develop's side (`our`) has `ariaDisabled = false` (added by commit `f62231c`, "fix(sfcc-92): accessibility fixes", merged via PR #86), the PR's side (`their`) has `sx` instead. `gh pr view 81 --json mergeable,mergeStateStatus` independently confirms `"mergeable":"CONFLICTING","mergeStateStatus":"DIRTY"`.
